title: Very Crispy Slovakian Fish Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring fish dumplings that are crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, made with custard powder and spherified for a unique texture. This recipe is perfect for a pescatarian meal prep.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, custard powder, and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add in the water and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Divide the dough into small pieces and shape into dumplings.
In a separate bowl, mix the sodium alginate with water to create a spherification bath.
Gently add the dumplings to the spherification bath and let them sit for 30 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully add the dumplings to the hot oil and fry until golden brown.
Remove the dumplings from the oil and place on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the crispy fish dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
